# 远程与投掷武器｜v1生成提示词

生成方式：内置 imagegen。图像参考仅用于视觉设计，非原游戏3D模型。

## 母图

Use case: stylized-concept. Roblox survival game replacement asset concept in a coherent simplified LOW-POLY 3D family. Chunky bevels, clearly faceted surfaces, matte materials, 5-8 readable main shapes, restrained wear and restrained technology glow. Neutral warm beige studio background, soft shadows, clean complete isolated object, no environment, no real people, no caption, no labels, no watermark. This is visual game concept art, NOT a functional blueprint. No realistic gore, decay, blood, exposed organs or gun cutaways. Do NOT copy square machine plinths or energy generators from style references. NO base or platform unless intrinsically part of edible bowl; maintain appropriate natural silhouette. Create a FAMILY DESIGN MASTER contact sheet, 4 columns, 4 rows, exactly 16 distinct objects, one object per occupied cell, leave remaining cells blank. All cells use same elevated front-right camera and identical material language. Each object complete, clear separation, generous margins. No three views here; ONE view per object. Keep handgrip/attachment dimensions comparable within families; animals retain squirrel < hyena < bear/deathclaw relative sizes, no forced equal real-world height. Composition cell order is LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM. The designs in exact cell order:
1. Compact chunky yellow/black stun sidearm, two square emitter apertures, small diagnostic panel, no real-world branding.
2. Simple blued steel six-chamber revolver, modest straight barrel, brown wood grip, plain iron sights; no bullets or labels.
3. Crude grey pipe bolt-action rifle, one bent bolt handle, rough wooden stock, dark cloth reinforcement, no cross-section or machining details.
4. Break-action SIDE-BY-SIDE double barrel hunting shotgun, TWO wide barrels, dark steel receiver, chunky brown wood fore-end and stock.
5. White/graphite electromagnetic sniper rifle, two long parallel accelerator rails, ONE optic and compact capacitor block, cyan seams, no ammo schematic.
6. Simple laminated wood hunting bow with leather centre grip, taut string, one separate matching arrow with SEALED green toxin head; keep arrow aside, no firing pose.
7. One closed green glass game-prop bottle, wrapped brown cloth neck and orange pictogram band, NO flame, no exposed igniter, no construction diagram.
8. Chunky dark steel light machine gun, long ribbed barrel, round drum magazine, folded compact bipod and brown reinforced stock, no tripod or loose cartridges.
9. Stylized shoulder launcher with dark tube, olive insulated middle, broad stylized inert nose cone, small side sight and rear flared exhaust, no cutaway or ammunition dimensions.
10. Refined silver revolver, black grip, short upper tactical sight rail, subtle snake-scale grip pattern, compact muzzle, no engraving text.
11. Graphite/titanium compound bow, exactly two end cams and compact battery grip, small sight, ONE separate arrow with cyan cold-tech collar; no crystal ice bow.
12. Compact angular charcoal submachine gun, short barrel, straight box magazine and folded wire stock, simple iron sights, no four-barrel assembly.
13. Portable short-barrel grenade launcher, oversized six-lobed cylinder, vertical foregrip and folded skeleton shoulder stock, dark grey/olive with orange hazard inset, no loose grenades.
14. Sleek compact black/grey BULLPUP rifle, magazine clearly BEHIND grip, integrated small optic, clean composite angular panels, no glowing energy barrel.
15. White/graphite gauss rifle, distinctive TWO parallel tuning-fork accelerator rails, small cyan seams, detachable battery-shaped block and integral optic, clear separate stock/receiver/barrel masses.
16. Palm-sized silver cylindrical pulse capsule with round blue crystal inset, compact ribbed collar, no cross/religious symbol, closed shell, no cutaway or explosive assembly.
